question: List each building key and floor key within the department of facilities, the number of rooms, total area, average area per floor, building name, access level, zip code, and city. Include subtotals for each building and a grand total across all buildings. The subtotals and grand total should not include zip code or city. Numbers of rooms and area should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.

prediction.sql:
WITH dof_rooms AS (
    SELECT 
        r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
        r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY,
        r.AREA
    FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
    JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
    WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_NAME = 'DP OF FACILITIES'
),
floor_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        d.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
        d.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rooms,
        SUM(d.AREA) AS total_area,
        AVG(d.AREA) AS avg_area
    FROM dof_rooms d
    GROUP BY d.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, d.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
)
SELECT 
    s.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    s.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY,
    FORMAT(CAST(s.num_rooms AS SIGNED), 0) AS num_rooms,
    FORMAT(CAST(s.total_area AS SIGNED), 0) AS total_area,
    FORMAT(CAST(s.avg_area AS SIGNED), 0) AS avg_area_per_floor,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME,
    ba.POSTAL_CODE,
    ba.CITY
FROM floor_stats s
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON s.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS ba ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY s.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.BUILDING_ROOM, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fba.BUILDING_NUMBER FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 100 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fba.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES') SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.POSTAL_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_num_window FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER = fba.BUILDING_NUMBER), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') SELECT ic.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.FLOOR, ic.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ic.AREA, (ic.AREA - avg_floor_area.avg_area) AS area_deviation_from_floor_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT FLOOR, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR) AS avg_floor_area ON ic.FLOOR = avg_floor_area.FLOOR) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.AREA, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.BUILDING_NUMBER, s1.POSTAL_CODE, s1.row_num_window, s2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s2.FLOOR, s2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2.AREA AS s2_AREA, s2.area_deviation_from_floor_avg FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NUMBER = s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.AREA

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_rooms FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sf.FLOOR_NAME LIKE '%Floor%'

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, fbh.CAMPUS_SECTOR, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT'), access_level_variance AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY access_level_code_sort, campus_sector_sort) = ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE THEN NULL ELSE ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE END AS access_level_code, ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, campus_sector, num_of_rooms_variance, ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE AS join_access_level_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE END AS access_level_code_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE CAMPUS_SECTOR END AS campus_sector, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE CAMPUS_SECTOR END AS campus_sector_sort, ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, MAX(ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME) AS ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, CAMPUS_SECTOR WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY access_level_code_sort, campus_sector_sort), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fr.AREA FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '36'), floor_area_stats AS (SELECT f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(i.AREA) - MIN(i.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(i.AREA) AS area_variance, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE AS join_access_level_code FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS f ON i.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG GROUP BY f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) SELECT alv.access_level_code, alv.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, alv.campus_sector, alv.num_of_rooms_variance, fas.FLOOR, fas.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fas.area_range, fas.area_variance FROM access_level_variance AS alv JOIN floor_area_stats AS fas ON alv.join_access_level_code = fas.join_access_level_code ORDER BY alv.access_level_code, alv.campus_sector, fas.FLOOR

SELECT f.FLOOR_NAME, SUM(d.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS total_square_footage FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS f ON d.FLOOR_KEY = f.FLOOR_KEY WHERE d.ROOM_NUMBER > 20 AND d.BUILDING_COMPONENT <> '13' AND d.BUILDING_KEY = 32 GROUP BY f.FLOOR_NAME HAVING SUM(d.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) > 0
